signs.sub: A plunger fixes the easy ones. When it doesn't — or it keeps coming back — something bigger is going on.

cards.title: A Stubborn Clog
cards.body: Too much paper, wipes, or a dropped object stuck in the trap where a plunger can't reach.

cards.title: It Keeps Happening
cards.body: Repeat overflows usually mean a partial blockage in the drain line, not just the toilet.

cards.title: Other Drains Back Up
cards.body: Gurgling tubs or water coming up in the shower point to a main sewer line problem.

cards.title: Tree Roots & Old Pipes
cards.body: Roots and aging pipes narrow the sewer line until waste has nowhere to go but up.

compare.h2: Do This First, Then Call Us

items: Turn the valve on the wall behind the toilet clockwise until it stops

Don't flush again — every flush adds more water
Hold off on sinks and showers if other drains are slow

water-heater-checkup.description: Is your water heater 8 years or older? Book a free water heater inspection with Lincoln Plumbing & Rooter in San Bernardino and the Inland Empire. Call 909-780-0887.

hero.lede: If it's 8 years or older, it's time to take a look. Book a free water heater inspection and find out whether yours has years left — or is about to quit on a cold morning.

signs.h2: Signs It's Time For A Look
signs.sub: Most tank water heaters last roughly 8 to 12 years. The age is usually on the label on the side of the tank.

cards.title: 8+ Years Old
cards.body: Past the 8-year mark, tanks are more likely to leak. An inspection tells you where yours stands.

cards.title: Rusty Or Cloudy Water
cards.body: Discolored hot water can mean corrosion inside the tank.

cards.title: Popping Or Rumbling
cards.body: Noise usually means sediment has built up on the bottom of the tank.

cards.title: Runs Out Fast
cards.body: Hot water that doesn't last like it used to is a common sign of a tired heater.

compare.sub: No pressure, no obligation. Just a clear answer about your water heater.

cards.title: What We Check
items: Age, condition and signs of corrosion or leaks
Pressure relief valve and water connections
Sediment buildup and burner or elements
Venting and code issues on gas units

cards.title: What You Walk Away With
items: An honest repair-or-replace recommendation
Upfront pricing if anything needs work
